issues.current: Agreement 'signed by the second visit or within seven calendar days... whichever comes first'. 'Include rate, hours, cancellation terms'.
issues.correct: Rule .09(2)(b): second visit counts only if it is on a different day from the first, otherwise 7 calendar days. Rule .09(2)(c): the client may cancel at any time and pays only for services rendered. The provider may charge only a 'reasonable charge for travel and staff time' for late cancellations. Rule .09(2)(a) lists mandatory contents.
issues.evidence: Rule text: 'A client has the right to cancel any service agreement at any time'. Also required: the DCH phone number, a client-rights acknowledgment (.12), and authorization for access to client funds or the client's vehicle.
issues.fix: Add: 'Do not use minimum-hour or non-cancellable terms. Cancellation fees are limited to a reasonable travel/staff-time charge. The agreement must include the 10 required elements of .09(2)(a). If the second visit is on a different day, sign by then; otherwise sign within 7 calendar days.'
